title: Prioritising when everything feels urgent
summary: A simple way to sort tasks when you are stretched.
body: When demand is high, the question is not “how do I do everything?” but “what matters most this week?”
List your tasks and mark each one: must happen, should happen, can wait. Share the list with your manager and ask them to confirm the “can wait” items.
Protecting a short block of time each day for the one most important task helps stop the day being swallowed by interruptions.
